html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly digest · July 15, 2024

China funding

Sequoia China (红杉中国) — raised a ¥18B (~$2.5B) RMB fund for China tech startups under Neil Shen, despite geopolitics and a soft macro. LPs include Hangzhou government and state/private insurers. Smaller than the 2022 $9B USD fund, but still the largest China PE/VC raise of the prior year. Separation from Sequoia parent and possible USD-fund constraints imply a more cautious stance in sensitive tech. (FT)

Chaohai Tech (超嗨科技) — smart shopping carts; tens of millions RMB from Zhongcai Rongshang green-materials fund. Founded 2015; AI + sensors + big data; eight functions (ID, precision marketing, self-checkout, etc.).

Jiuke Info (九科信息) — B1 tens of millions RMB; cumulative ~¥100M; Nuohui lead, Shenzhen Capital SOSF follow. Cloud-native RPA+AI+low-code+process mining; bit-IDP / bit-Bot; Xinchuang certified; finance & energy; >20% SOE penetration.

Overseas funding

Hebbia — $130M a16z lead; Index, GV, Thiel; valuation $700M. Matrix agent platform for complex analysis; multi-source unstructured data; clients include U.S. Air Force, finance, law. CEO George Sivulka: R&D + hiring. (est. 2020)

Solidroad — $1.2M seed — AI hiring / onboarding / training. Angels include Dan Kiely (Voxpro), Jack Pierce (Wayflyer), Ciaran Lee (Intercom). Founders Mark Hughes & Patrick Finlay.

Captions — $60M; valuation $500M; Index lead; Jared Leto among followers; cumulative ~$100M. AI “creative studio”: avatars, edit, dubbing, multilingual captions; Lipdub; education, real estate, sales.

Roboat — €550k LUMO Labs + SHIFT Invest. MIT/AMS spinout; autonomous urban watercraft; AI situational awareness; already assisting Amsterdam GVB IJveer ferry captains.

Synerise — $8.5M B+ (Poland) with VTEX + angels. Behavior modeling / big data; deepen VTEX AI retail stack. CEOs Królewski / Thomaz on partnership.

Volley — $55M Series C M12 + Lightspeed; cumulative >$75M. AI voice games; GPT-4o expected ~3× response speed; consumer AI companions; ARR >$30M (2×); subs $9.99–$12.99/mo; platform take 10–30%.

Groq — ~$300M imminent, BlackRock lead; valuation $2.2B (2× 2021). Founder Jonathan Ross (ex-Google TPU). Fast LLM inference; pivoting to cloud to cut customer hardware risk; rivals Etched, Taalas. (The Information)

Fireworks AI — $52M Series B (Jul 12); valuation $552M; Sequoia, Nvidia, AMD. Enterprise fine-tune/infer/deploy; 100+ optimized models; ~40× faster inference vs GPT-4 claim; 140B tokens/day; 99.99% API; LoRA; FireAttention V2 / Firefunction-v2; customers Cresta, Cursor, DoorDash.

Events

Yuanchuang Future AI Fund (Shanghai) — Lingang + Futeng; LPs Shanghai state LP, Lingang Holding, SenseTime; first close ¥512.1M; Shanghai AI & metaverse. Launched around WAIC.

Humanoid bank-lobby training base — first in China at CCB Shanghai Pudong branch (Jul 11): consult, routing, guidance, anti-fraud. Industry size forecast >¥20B by 2026.

Doosan Enerbility × POSCO RIST — AI for sintering efficiency/quality; in-year pilot on POSCO lines.

a16z “Oxygen” — building >20k GPU pool (thousands of H100s already) for portfolio companies to rent; scale toward xAI-class. (The Information)

Samsung Foundry Forum (Jul 9, Seoul) — Choi Si-young: close gap with TSMC; differentiated AI turnkey; BCD + sensors; HBM + 2.5D; 2nm production next year; 1nm by 2027.

Microsoft & Apple drop OpenAI board observer seats amid EU/U.S. scrutiny; Microsoft GC Keith Dolliver: new board progress makes observer role unnecessary (non-voting seat after Altman ouster saga).

Index Ventures — $2.3B new capital ($800M Fund XII + $1.5B Fund VII); 108 unicorns; 23 >$10B; 57 IPOs; ~200k jobs ecosystem.

Galaxy Z Fold6 / Flip6 (+ Buds3/Pro) — Paris Unpacked Jul 10; Snapdragon 8 Gen3 + Google Gemini; next chapter of Galaxy AI / Flex modes.

xAI–Oracle cloud deal collapses; Musk building in-house Memphis supercomputer for AI training (target fall 2025); ~$10B potential Oracle deal off; Oracle −4.8% one day. Grok 2 trained on 24k H100s at Oracle; near-term 100k H100 liquid-cooled cluster; +300k B200 by next summer; also AWS and X/Twitter DC spare. (X)

SoftBank acquires Graphcore (Jul 11) — full subsidiary, brand kept. Bristol IPU designer (2016); peak valuation ~$3B; Microsoft, Sequoia among prior backers; growth missed amid contracts/policy. (Reuters)

People

Ren Chengyuan — ex-JD Tech VP; founded Beijing Xinzhi Ti (Sep prior year); Renmin Univ IS master’s; early JD; cloud solutions + AI open platform; co-team Li Yuanchun PhD, Xu Guangxin.

Gu Jiawei — ex-Baidu IDL HCI lead / Ling thing founder; new co. “Ling Yuzhou” — relational interactive LLM for home consumer robots; three rounds in ~6 months (Tsinghua SEE, Yaotu, SenseTime). Co-founder Xu Chiheng (ex-SenseTime co-founder / chief architect); AI-OS + hardware.

— END —
